sources.summary: The S-1 registration statement became effective at 4:00 PM Eastern on October 30. This is registration effectiveness, not SEC approval or endorsement of the securities, Evernorth, an XRP purchase plan, or the ELOC's satisfaction of every commencement condition.

The issuer filing list reviewed through November 7 showed the October 30 424B3 and the November 2 EFFECT notice as the latest relevant ELOC records; no later 8-K, 424B5 or purchase notice documenting an ELOC draw was located. This is absence of located public evidence, not proof that no transaction occurred.

actual_cash_and_assets.xrp_purchase_cost_source: Append-only correction artifact research/xrp_intelligence/20261107T113335Z-evernorth-c07-average-cost-correction-supersession.json; it supersedes only the prior erroneous average-cost formula and preserves the original artifacts.
actual_cash_and_assets.classification: The $47.6M trust-account release is SPAC trust cash after redemptions, not new outside subscription capital. The $10.5M delayed cash was not identified as part of the $214M XRP purchase. In-kind XRP contributions are not cash purchases.

convertible_notes.purchaser: NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., as trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3
convertible_notes.classification: Actual debt financing; not equity and not proof the proceeds were spent on XRP.

ripple_company_facility.repayment_terms: Due within five business days after the 2026-10-09 Closing Date or earlier on Ripple demand.
ripple_company_facility.use_and_scope: Includes third-party payments Ripple made on behalf of Pathfinder and Evernorth and vendor payments Pathfinder made on Evernorth's behalf; it is related-party debt, not new equity capital or an XRP purchase receipt.

cantor_eloc.management_stated_use: Management expects a substantial portion of any proceeds to be used to acquire additional XRP, but has not determined the specific allocation among potential uses.
cantor_eloc.actual_proceeds_as_of_2026_10_30: The prospectus describes potential future proceeds; it does not establish an executed post-effective draw.
cantor_eloc.fee_status: Fully earned/non-refundable under the agreement; payment not independently confirmed.
cantor_eloc.additional_expense_terms: Prospectus also describes reimbursable legal/due-diligence expenses; these are costs, not capital.

public_warrants.proceeds_use: Broad corporate discretion; not specifically earmarked for XRP.

sbi_holdings.class_c_reason: Class C shares were issued to SBI in excess of the 39.9% Class A ownership limitation.
sbi_holdings.interpretation: SBI-controlled entities are direct Evernorth equity subscribers/shareholders. Do not attribute the entire $214.05M aggregate advance-funding cash to SBI.

ripple_ecosystem.source_of_sponsor_xrp: RippleWorks, Inc., a nonprofit foundation and limited partner of the Sponsor, contributed the XRP to the Sponsor, which then invested it.
ripple_ecosystem.trust_relationship: The SEC filing identifies the trust as an investor affiliated with Ripple.
ripple_ecosystem.classification: These are in-kind XRP contributions/equity subscriptions, not cash purchases.

sbic_distinction.distinction: Regional statutory SBIC entities are distinct from SBI Holdings, Inc. The SEC filing's defined term SBI means SBI Holdings, Inc.

accounting_reconciliation.actual_cash: Private-placement cash and the trust-account release are distinct sources; the rounded $272.6M aggregate includes the SPAC trust account and is not all new investor money.
accounting_reconciliation.actual_xrp_purchase: $214.0M was used to purchase 84,365,876.3625 XRP at an issuer-reported average cost of $2.53657058; $49,995 of the exact $214,049,995 cash receipt remained restricted.
accounting_reconciliation.in_kind: Approximately 388.91M XRP was contributed in kind; it must not be described as cash spent in the market.
accounting_reconciliation.debt: The $30M PIK note and $9.7M Pathfinder/Ripple facility draw are debt, not equity proceeds.
accounting_reconciliation.eloc: The ELOC registration is effective, but the Commencement Date depends on additional conditions. The $76.8M gross/$74.4M net amounts are illustrative potential proceeds at the cover price, not cash raised.
accounting_reconciliation.warrants: The $132.2M is a maximum if all public warrants exercise for cash; there is no assurance and use is broad.
accounting_reconciliation.sec_effectiveness: An EFFECT notice makes a registration statement effective; it is not SEC approval of Evernorth, its securities, an XRP purchase plan or expected returns.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: If the Cantor ELOC commences and is drawn, management expects a substantial portion of proceeds to fund additional XRP purchases.
support: Prospectus states expected substantial portion for XRP acquisitions
counterevidence: No public post-effective draw identified through Nov7
Share issuance and fees create dilution/costs

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The ELOC may be used for working capital, other corporate purposes, or not drawn at all.
support: Company retains discretion to sell all, some or none
counterevidence: Management states expected substantial portion for XRP if proceeds are raised

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Public warrants may provide cash only if holders elect cash exercise.
support: Up to $132.2M gross cash if all 11,499,992 warrants exercise at $11.50

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The $30M note provides actual debt financing but creates a much larger potential cash settlement obligation.
support: Up to $120M cash settlement upon conversion
counterevidence: Settlement is contingent on note terms and future events

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The $9.7M Pathfinder/Ripple facility may have been repaid, extended or otherwise settled after closing.
support: Contract required repayment within five business days after Oct9 closing
counterevidence: The Oct30 filing does not state settlement and no later public confirmation was located

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI is a major direct Evernorth shareholder and subscriber, but the full aggregate advance-funding cash cannot be attributed to SBI.
support: SBI-controlled entities hold 21.4% common and 39.9% voting power
counterevidence: Exact SBI cash amount per subscriber not isolated in the reviewed filing

disconfirming_evidence: ELOC registration effectiveness does not establish that all Commencement Date conditions were met or that any shares were sold.
No post-effective ELOC draw was located in the SEC filings reviewed through Nov7; absence of a filing is not proof no draw occurred.
The ELOC upfront fee was due Nov6 and is non-refundable even if no purchases occur; payment is not independently confirmed.
Public warrant exercise is optional; no exercise proceeds were verified.
The $30M PIK notes are debt and may create a cash settlement obligation up to $120M.
The $9.7M Ripple facility is debt with a post-closing repayment obligation; settlement status is unresolved.
The 388.91M XRP in-kind contributions are not cash purchases from the open market.
The $47.6M trust-account release is SPAC trust cash after redemptions, not new subscription capital.
SBI's 21.4% common ownership and 39.9% voting power do not disclose the exact dollar amount of SBI's share of aggregate cash subscriptions.

exact_phrase_research.actual_capital: No new issuer-primary use of the exact phrase 'actual capital' was found. The primary filings require a cash/debt/in-kind/contingent-capacity ledger rather than one headline number.
exact_phrase_research.secondary_headline_correction: A secondary headline describing the SEC as approving Evernorth to raise money to buy XRP overstates the record. The EFFECT notice is registration effectiveness; the prospectus explicitly says the SEC has not approved or disapproved the securities.
exact_phrase_research.sbic_chatgpt: SBI Holdings, Inc. in the SEC filing is distinct from regional SBIC East/Central/West. Tokyo SBIC's ChatGPT/Microsoft seminars are education events, not an OpenAI partnership.

source_limitations: SEC filings are issuer-authored disclosures; excerpt hashes are preserved but complete raw SEC bytes and response headers were not retained.
The EDGAR search found no later public draw/repayment filing through Nov7, but absence of a filing is not proof of no transaction.
Exact per-entity SBI cash subscription amounts were not isolated in the reviewed filings.
The ELOC's full Commencement Date conditions and post-effective draw status were not independently confirmed.

model_eligibility.permitted_use: Point-in-time corporate/event and capital-structure context only; not a price-direction feature without independently verified transaction dates and actual cash/asset flows.
